market_notes: Portuguese serves Portugal and Brazil. Live pages already mix European forms (Vietname, carta de condução, caução) with Brazilian 'aluguel', so titles stay in European Portuguese while queries carry Brazilian variants (Vietnã, CNH, PID, embreagem). Brazilian travellers ask whether a CNH category A plus a PID is enough; Portuguese advice explicitly warns against leaving a passport as deposit.

proposals.working_title: Conduzir uma moto semiautomática: mudanças sem embraiagem
proposals.intent_rationale: Visitors who have only ridden automatic scooters search for how to operate a clutchless semi-automatic before choosing one; how-to intent, distinct from the manual-versus-automatic choice guide.

proposals.working_title: 110, 125 ou 150 cc: que cilindrada para cidade e montanha?
proposals.intent_rationale: Riders planning mountain routes compare engine capacity and ask what their licence class permits; complements the 50cc/electric guide, which covers the low-power end.

proposals.working_title: Deixar o passaporte como caução: riscos e alternativas
proposals.intent_rationale: Leaving an identity document as security is a recurring traveller worry that official travel advice addresses; covers risks and questions to ask, never a provider's policy. The Portal das Comunidades explicitly warns against leaving a passport as deposit when renting a vehicle.

proposals.working_title: Além do preço do aluguer: combustível, estacionamento, entrega e danos

proposals.primary_query: permissão internacional para dirigir vietnã moto
proposals.working_title: PID e carta internacional: conduzir moto no Vietname
proposals.intent_rationale: Licence validity is the highest-stakes rental question. This guide is scoped to the international permit itself, separate from the home-licence guide, and must follow current official sources. Brazilian readers ask about the PID with a CNH category A; Portuguese readers about the carta de condução internacional.

proposals.primary_query: moto alugada roubada vietnã quem paga
proposals.working_title: Danos e roubo: a responsabilidade no contrato de aluguer
proposals.intent_rationale: Disputes over scratches, damage and theft are a major source of rental conflict; explains clauses to read and evidence to keep, without legal promises.
proposals.research_gap: Civil-law liability sources are not attached; drafting must cite the governing civil-code provisions or stay at questions-to-ask level.

proposals.intent_rationale: Riders want to know what compulsory liability insurance covers and whether travel insurance pays after a crash; needs current decree references (67/2023 as amended by 220/2026) and policy-specific caveats.

proposals.working_title: Fiscalização policial com moto alugada: o que esperar
